cc:Work.dc:title: Native Runtime Programs
cc:Work.dc:description: All 23 original source groups in the Phase102 native C runtime suite, sorted by geometric mean execution-time ratio to upstream C. Bars start at the 1x parity line on a logarithmic axis. Each source group weights its own cases equally; the headline instead weights all 44 positive-work cases equally. Lower is better.
